mapper.sql: d.demand_id, d.demand_no, d.client_id, d.title, d.genre_id, d.tags, d.budget, d.deadline, d.requirement, d.contact_info, d.submission_count, d.total_episodes, d.status, d.accepted_creator_id, d.accepted_at, d.duration_hours, d.due_at, d.is_overdue, d.escrow_amount, d.escrow_status, d.deposit_amount, d.deposit_status, d.deposit_paid_at, d.deposit_settled_at, d.fail_reason, d.fail_at, d.created_at, d.updated_at, d.create_by, d.create_time, d.update_by, d.update_time, d.remark, uc.nick_name as client_name, ua.nick_name as accepted_creator_name
from sys_demand d left join sys_user uc on d.client_id = uc.user_id left join sys_user ua on d.accepted_creator_id = ua.user_id

sql.if: AND (d.title like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or d.demand_no like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

mapper.select: select count(*) as availableCount, coalesce(sum(budget), 0) as prizePoolYuan, sum(case when date(created_at) = curdate() then 1 else 0 end) as todayNewCount from sys_demand where status = 'open' and escrow_status = 'escrowed'
select genre_id as genreId, count(*) as cnt from sys_demand where status = 'open' and escrow_status = 'escrowed' group by genre_id

select d.demand_id, d.demand_no, d.client_id, d.title, d.genre_id, d.tags, d.budget, d.deadline, d.requirement, d.contact_info, d.submission_count, d.total_episodes, d.status, d.accepted_creator_id, d.accepted_at, d.duration_hours, d.due_at, d.is_overdue, d.escrow_amount, d.escrow_status, d.deposit_amount, d.deposit_status, d.deposit_paid_at, d.deposit_settled_at, d.fail_reason, d.fail_at, d.created_at, d.updated_at, d.create_by, d.create_time, d.update_by, d.update_time, d.remark, uc.nick_name as client_name, ua.nick_name as accepted_creator_name from sys_demand d left join sys_user uc on d.client_id = uc.user_id left join sys_user ua on d.accepted_creator_id = ua.user_id where d.demand_id = #{demandId}
mapper.insert: insert into sys_demand ( demand_no, client_id, title, genre_id, tags, budget, deadline, requirement, contact_info, submission_count, total_episodes, duration_hours, status, escrow_amount, escrow_status, create_by, create_time, remark ) values ( #{demandNo}, #{clientId}, #{title}, #{genreId}, #{tags}, #{budget}, #{deadline}, #{requirement}, #{contactInfo}, #{submissionCount}, #{totalEpisodes}, #{durationHours}, #{status}, #{escrowAmount}, #{escrowStatus}, #{createBy}, #{createTime}, #{remark} )
mapper.update: update sys_demand set status = #{status}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() where demand_id = #{demandId}

update sys_demand set status = 'in_progress', accepted_creator_id = #{creatorId}, accepted_at = #{acceptedAt}, due_at = #{dueAt}, is_overdue = 0, deposit_amount = #{depositAmount}, deposit_status = 'held', deposit_paid_at = NOW(), update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() where demand_id = #{demandId} and status = 'open' and escrow_status = 'escrowed'
update sys_demand set escrow_status = 'escrowed', updated_at = NOW() where demand_id = #{demandId}

update sys_demand
status = #{status}, escrow_status = #{escrowStatus},
deposit_status = #{depositStatus}, deposit_settled_at = NOW(),
fail_reason = #{failReason}, fail_at = NOW(),
updated_at = NOW()
where demand_id = #{demandId}
update sys_demand set is_overdue = 1, updated_at = NOW() where demand_id = #{demandId}

update sys_demand
status = #{status}, escrow_status = #{escrowStatus},
deposit_status = #{depositStatus}, deposit_settled_at = NOW(),
fail_reason = #{failReason}, fail_at = NOW(),
updated_at = NOW()
where demand_id = #{demandId} and status = 'in_progress'
update sys_demand set submission_count = submission_count + 1, updated_at = NOW() where demand_id = #{demandId}
